brief: How to have a perfect glow skin — 5 steps from a dermatologist.

slots.author: DR. ELENA VOSS
slots.subtitle: A DERMATOLOGIST'S RITUAL FOR RADIANT SKIN

slots.author: DR. ELENA VOSS
slots.title: CLEANSE & PURIFY
slots.body: Start with a gentle, pH-balanced cleanser to remove impurities without stripping your skin's natural moisture barrier. This prepares your complexion to absorb every active ingredient that follows.

slots.author: DR. ELENA VOSS
slots.title: EXFOLIATE WEEKLY
slots.body: Use a mild chemical exfoliant once or twice a week to dissolve dead cells and reveal a smoother, more luminous texture. Avoid harsh scrubs that can cause micro-tears and irritation.

slots.author: DR. ELENA VOSS
slots.title: HYDRATE DEEPLY
slots.body: Layer a hyaluronic acid serum followed by a ceramide-rich moisturizer to lock in plumping hydration. Well-hydrated skin reflects light beautifully and feels supple throughout the day.

slots.author: DR. ELENA VOSS
slots.title: TREAT & REPAIR
slots.body: Apply a vitamin C serum each morning to brighten and shield against environmental stressors. At night, consider retinol to support cell turnover and collagen production over time.

slots.author: DR. ELENA VOSS
slots.title: SHIELD WITH SPF
slots.body: Daily broad-spectrum sunscreen is the ultimate anti-aging and glow-preserving step. UV damage dulls the complexion, so protection keeps your radiance intact year-round.

slots.author: DR. ELENA VOSS
slots.title: REST & RESET
slots.body: Prioritize seven to nine hours of quality sleep to allow your skin to regenerate. Stress management and clean pillowcases also support a calm, clear complexion.

slots.author: DR. ELENA VOSS
slots.headline: START TODAY
slots.body: Begin your personalized glow journey with expert guidance and medical-grade formulas designed for your unique skin.
